Game Overview

In Miss Yuuno 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling quest in Miss Yuuno 2, where you journey as an amnesiac girl striving to reclaim her lost memories. Master the double jump to deftly navigate perilous levels, evading shadowy monsters and hidden traps. Experience the suspenseful, anime-inspired world and unravel Yuuno’s mysterious past.
